_doc: The first hatch (onboarding_beats.dart HatchScreen, hatch_timeline.dart). Times in seconds from the tap. A beat can play a sound (sfx, vol), a haptic feel (buzz: a Haptic name), shake the egg (shake: strength 0-1), raise its cracks (crack: 1-3), burst it (burst), or start a reaction on the creature (react: emerge, look, hatch = its personality's signature). Phases: A quiet 0-0.6, B shaking 0.6-1.3, C cracks 1.3-2.0, D burst 2.0-2.3, E reveal 2.1-3.0, F payoff 3.0-4.3, then the name card. styles: each egg's light and the shape of its burst (motes, leaves, sparks, droplets, grit, stars); every burst also carries the gold Lumen motes.
